instrument: Siril load + boxselect + stat (every per-box number is Siril's); in-house is the grid bookkeeping and the largest-all-covered-rectangle search
criterion: a box is COVERED when Siril Min on the Green layer is >= floor — the sibling-class sky floor, never mere non-zero, and never the worst channel (the low channel clips to zero on fully covered sky in this class)
